description: Precedence, conflict rules and the label to workflow-state compatibility mapping for the GitHub workflow projection. Extends the lifecycle reconciler; it is not a second policy authority.

unknownReasons.api_outage: GitHub API unreachable; Factory continues from its own state and the projection is queued.
unknownReasons.restricted_write: The token cannot write labels; projection is waiting for a permitted actor.
unknownReasons.webhook_loss: No event was seen for longer than the staleness window; level-triggered resync is required.
unknownReasons.approval_unverified: GitHub review state could not be read; approval is UNKNOWN, never assumed.
